newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu to break into China lubricant oil market.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu to break into China lubricant oil market.

text.p: Japanese refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Thursday that Taiwanese lubricants maker Kuo Horng Co Ltd will produce and market lubricants for cars and industrial machinery in China from next year.
Kuo Horng is 25 percent owned by Idemitsu.
The lubricants will be sold under the Idemitsu brand name, a spokesman for the refiner said.

A lubricants plant with an annual production capacity of 15,000 kilolitres is already being built in Changzhou, 200 kilometres northwest of Shanghai, he said. The plant is expected to start commercial production next spring.
Idemitsu opened its first service station in China on November 1.
